learned_arms.direct_mlp: Unstructured capacity control predicting h_t+1 directly
learned_arms.physical_tau: Predict h_inf(V) and positive tau_h(V), then apply the exponential solver
learned_arms.direct_z: Predict bounded h_inf(V) and z(V,dt), then apply a convex update

reference_arms.linear_rate_lut: Linear interpolation of h_inf and log(tau_h) sampled only on fit voltages

task1b_informed_budget.reason: Task 1 and Task 1b selected 0.003 and localized the dominant residual limitation to optimization budget rather than a robust capacity or objective main effect.

fairness.seed_policy: checkpoint selected by mean development score across all three seeds; no seed selection

registered_engineering_continuation_gate.meaning: A joint m+h experiment may start while h accuracy remains explicit refinement debt; this is not a pass of the scientific gate.

registered_diagnostics.budget_limited: The selected family improves by at least 20% from 10000 to its selected later checkpoint without a development reversal before selection.
registered_diagnostics.structured_bias_supported: Physical-tau beats direct_mlp and direct_z on aggregate sealed RMSE without violating [0,1].
registered_diagnostics.stratum_localization: Report in-support, OOD-voltage and OOD-dt separately, including h_inf and log(tau_h) errors.

interpretation.positive: The held-voltage h-gate primitive is atomically learnable under the registered budget.
interpretation.negative: Failure remains localized to the h primitive and must be diagnosed before a joint m+h cell.
interpretation.forbidden_claim: No result from this task establishes sufficiency under a varying or endogenous voltage path, and an engineering continuation pass is not a scientific-gate pass.
